scope: All 50 November candidates across 13WMAZ, 41NBC, AJC, GPB, NPR, WGXA and The Macon Newsroom.
method: Candidate-by-candidate web searches, native WGXA and Macon Newsroom searches, publisher article and structured metadata review, and attached Chrome verification for 13WMAZ and NPR. Prioritized current election profiles, recent reporting and substantive historical candidate coverage. This is a verified result set, not an exhaustive archive inventory.
notes: General web search missed native archive results. 13WMAZ archive search returned Access Denied, while linked stories were accessible in Chrome. NPR web-tool access was blocked; its original story was verified in Chrome. These limitations are not evidence of no coverage.
Original publication dates are retained when articles were later updated. 41NBC dates use the visible calendar date rather than the UTC date. Fetched-on dates record verification on October 21.

No author person is created for collective staff, institutional bylines, or source organizations. Publisher and syndication source relationships are distinct. Candidate-authored opinion columns use the existing candidate record.

Unrelated people with matching names, related-story promotions, and ambiguous Leland Olinger identities were excluded. Bartell’s historical AJC coverage was verified using the Al Bartell variant; no unambiguous coverage was verified for the other ten write-ins.
Existing URLs, metadata, visibility and relationships are preserved. Only article metadata and associations are stored; article bodies are not copied.
